title: ecbolium nothum
intro: Ecbolium nothum, commonly known as Indian spikenard or false valerian, is a flowering plant species found in tropical regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Ecbolium nothum are attributed to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it a sought-after remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
